content: {"rules": ["Forecast models consistently underestimate prices in the presence of high bearish sentiment and negative supply net events.", "Model forecasts show a persistent upward bias after major auction events, indicating lagged market reaction.", "Sentiment spikes during auction periods correlate with forecast overshoots, suggesting sentiment amplifies price movements.", "Price mean-reversion is evident when sentiment shifts from bullish to bearish, especially after consecutive auction supply events.", "Forecast accuracy deteriorates when bearish sentiment exceeds bullish sentiment by more than 20 units in event balance.", "Models fail to capture sudden price reversals triggered by consecutive auction supply events in CAP3 EU markets.", "Forecast models should adjust for supply net events exceeding -20 units, as this triggers significant price volatility.", "Sentiment history should be weighted more heavily in forecasting when official event balance is negative and bearish sentiment dominates."]}
